people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua made himself flint knives, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
translations.bsb: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at Gibeath-haaraloth.
translations.kjv: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
translations.asv: And Joshua made him knives of lint, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
